application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: Whilst pruning of the western limb is considered reasonable, the Local Planning Authority considers that an alternative specification submitted for the same tree represents a more appropriate arboricultural solution. The alternative proposal would achieve the required clearance from the neighbouring property whilst also addressing additional management requirements, retaining a greater level of crown structure, screening value and public amenity. The Local Planning Authority therefore considers the alternative specification to represent the preferable management approach and the works proposed under this application are not supported.
description:
